Definition: tuyên bố, khẳng định; đòi, yêu cầu (quyền lợi)
Pattern: động từ (chính); cũng là danh từ; claim that; claim to do something
Examples: He claims that he saw the accident happen. | You can claim your money back if the product is faulty.

Definition: mệnh đề (ngữ pháp); điều khoản
Pattern: danh từ; relative clause = mệnh đề quan hệ; a clause in a contract
Examples: The contract has a clause about late payment. | In grammar, a sentence can contain more than one clause.

Definition: nhấp chuột; kêu lách cách
Pattern: động từ (chính); cũng là danh từ; click on something = nhấp vào
Examples: Click on the blue button to save your work. | The door closed with a soft click.

Definition: khách hàng (của dịch vụ), thân chủ
Pattern: danh từ; thường dùng cho dịch vụ chuyên môn; so với customer (mua hàng)
Examples: The lawyer met her new client at nine. | Our company works with clients all over the world.

Definition: vải, mảnh vải; khăn lau
Pattern: danh từ; không đếm được khi chỉ chất liệu; so với clothes (quần áo)
Examples: She wiped the table with a damp cloth. | The bag is made of strong cotton cloth.

Definition: manh mối, gợi ý, đầu mối
Pattern: danh từ; a clue to/about something; have no clue = không biết gì cả
Examples: The police found an important clue at the scene. | I have no clue where I left my keys.

Definition: than đá
Pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; a coal mine = mỏ than
Examples: The old train ran on coal. | Many families still burn coal to heat their homes.

Definition: đồng xu, tiền xu
Pattern: danh từ; so với note (tiền giấy); toss a coin = tung đồng xu
Examples: She dropped a coin into the fountain and made a wish. | He collects rare coins from different countries.

Definition: bộ sưu tập; sự thu gom
Pattern: danh từ; a collection of something; rubbish collection = việc thu gom rác
Examples: He has a huge collection of old records. | Rubbish collection happens every Tuesday here.

Definition: có màu, nhuộm màu
Pattern: tính từ; đứng trước danh từ; brightly coloured = màu sắc rực rỡ
Examples: The children drew pictures with brightly coloured pens. | She wore a dress covered in coloured beads.

Definition: kết hợp, phối hợp
Pattern: động từ; combine something with something; trái nghĩa với separate
Examples: She combines work with raising two children. | If you combine these two colours, you get green.

Definition: thương mại, mang tính buôn bán; quảng cáo (trên TV)
Pattern: tính từ (chính); cũng là danh từ (đoạn quảng cáo); commercial success
Examples: The film was a huge commercial success. | A loud commercial interrupted the match.

Definition: phạm (tội, lỗi); cam kết, dốc sức
Pattern: động từ; commit a crime; commit yourself to something = cam kết với
Examples: He was accused of committing a serious crime. | She committed herself fully to the new project.

Definition: sự giao tiếp, sự liên lạc
Pattern: danh từ; thường không đếm được; communication skills = kỹ năng giao tiếp
Examples: Good communication is important in any team. | Modern technology has made communication much faster.

Definition: sự so sánh
Pattern: danh từ; in comparison with/to = so với; make a comparison
Examples: In comparison with last year, sales have risen sharply. | There is no comparison between the two restaurants.

Definition: đối thủ cạnh tranh; người dự thi
Pattern: danh từ; một competitor in a race/market
Examples: Our main competitor just lowered its prices. | All the competitors lined up at the starting line.

Definition: cạnh tranh; thích ganh đua; (giá) phải chăng
Pattern: tính từ; a competitive person; competitive prices = giá cạnh tranh
Examples: He is very competitive and hates losing. | The shop offers competitive prices on phones.

Definition: lời phàn nàn, lời khiếu nại
Pattern: danh từ; make a complaint about something; trái nghĩa với compliment
Examples: I'd like to make a complaint about the service. | The hotel received several complaints about the noise.

Definition: phức tạp, rắc rối
Pattern: tính từ (chính); cũng là danh từ (khu phức hợp); trái nghĩa với simple
Examples: The rules of the game are quite complex. | Scientists are studying this complex problem.

Definition: tập trung, chú tâm
Pattern: động từ; concentrate on something; đồng nghĩa focus
Examples: I can't concentrate when the TV is on. | She concentrated hard on her exam questions.

Definition: kết luận; kết thúc
Pattern: động từ; conclude that; conclude a speech/meeting
Examples: The report concludes that the plan is too expensive. | The teacher concluded the lesson with a short quiz.

Definition: kết luận; sự kết thúc
Pattern: danh từ; come to/reach a conclusion = đi đến kết luận; in conclusion = tóm lại
Examples: After hours of talking, they reached no conclusion. | In conclusion, exercise is good for both body and mind.

Definition: tự tin; chắc chắn, tin tưởng
Pattern: tính từ; confident about/of something; confident that
Examples: She felt confident before the interview. | We are confident that the team will win.

Definition: xác nhận; khẳng định
Pattern: động từ; confirm a booking/that; đồng nghĩa verify
Examples: Please confirm your booking by email. | The doctor confirmed that he was fully recovered.

Definition: làm bối rối, làm lẫn lộn
Pattern: động từ; confuse A with B = nhầm A với B
Examples: The complicated map confused all the tourists. | People often confuse these two words.

Definition: bối rối, lúng túng, lẫn lộn
Pattern: tính từ; confused about something; get confused = bị rối
Examples: I was completely confused by his instructions. | She looked confused when nobody answered.

Definition: sự kết nối, mối liên hệ; chuyến nối tiếp
Pattern: danh từ; a connection between A and B; internet connection
Examples: There is a clear connection between smoking and illness. | I missed my connection because the first train was late.

Definition: hậu quả, kết quả kéo theo
Pattern: danh từ; as a consequence of something = do hậu quả của
Examples: He never thinks about the consequences of his actions. | As a consequence of the storm, many flights were cancelled.

Definition: gồm có, bao gồm
Pattern: động từ; consist of something; không dùng ở thì tiếp diễn
Examples: The team consists of five players. | Breakfast consisted of bread, eggs and coffee.

Definition: tiêu thụ, tiêu dùng; ăn, uống
Pattern: động từ; consume energy/food; đồng nghĩa use up
Examples: This old fridge consumes a lot of electricity. | Children should not consume too much sugar.

Definition: người tiêu dùng, khách tiêu thụ
Pattern: danh từ; consumer rights = quyền lợi người tiêu dùng
Examples: Consumers today want cheaper and greener products. | The new law protects consumers from unfair prices.

Definition: sự liên lạc, sự tiếp xúc; người quen biết
Pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ (liên lạc); be in contact with; get in touch
Examples: Keep in contact with me while you're abroad. | She has useful contacts in the music industry.

Definition: thùng chứa, vật đựng; công-ten-nơ
Pattern: danh từ; a container for something; a shipping container
Examples: Put the leftover rice in a plastic container. | The goods arrived in a huge metal container.

Definition: nội dung; (số nhiều) những thứ bên trong
Pattern: danh từ; the contents of a book/bag; online content
Examples: The website offers free content for students. | She emptied the contents of her bag onto the table.

Definition: liên tục, không gián đoạn
Pattern: tính từ; đồng nghĩa constant; so với continual (ngắt quãng lặp lại)
Examples: We heard a continuous noise from the building site. | The machine ran in continuous operation all night.

Definition: sự tương phản, sự đối lập
Pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ; in contrast to/with; by contrast
Examples: There is a sharp contrast between the rich and the poor here. | In contrast to his brother, he is very quiet.

Definition: thuận tiện, tiện lợi
Pattern: tính từ; convenient for somebody; trái nghĩa với inconvenient
Examples: The shop is very convenient because it opens late. | Is Monday a convenient day for our meeting?

Definition: thuyết phục; làm cho tin
Pattern: động từ; convince somebody to do something; convince somebody that
Examples: I couldn't convince him to change his mind. | She convinced me that the plan would work.

Definition: trang phục (hóa trang, biểu diễn)
Pattern: danh từ; a Halloween costume; so với clothes (quần áo thường)
Examples: The children wore animal costumes to the party. | Each dancer had a bright, colourful costume.

Definition: nhà tranh, nhà nhỏ ở nông thôn
Pattern: danh từ; a country cottage = nhà nhỏ ở quê
Examples: They spent the weekend in a cottage by the sea. | The old cottage had a thatched roof and a small garden.

Definition: bông, vải cotton
Pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; a cotton shirt = áo cotton
Examples: This T-shirt is made of pure cotton. | Cotton is grown in many warm countries.

Definition: vùng nông thôn, miền quê
Pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; in the countryside = ở miền quê
Examples: We love walking in the countryside at weekends. | Life in the countryside is slower and quieter.

Definition: tòa án; sân (thể thao)
Pattern: danh từ; go to court = ra tòa; a tennis court
Examples: The case will go to court next month. | They played two sets on the tennis court.

Definition: bìa (sách); vỏ bọc; nơi trú ẩn
Pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ (che phủ); take cover = tìm chỗ trú
Examples: The book has a beautiful cover. | When the rain started, we took cover under a tree.

Definition: được che phủ, phủ đầy
Pattern: tính từ; covered in/with something = phủ đầy
Examples: By morning the fields were covered in snow. | His hands were covered with paint.

Definition: tàn nhẫn, độc ác, tàn bạo
Pattern: tính từ; cruel to somebody/something; trái nghĩa với kind
Examples: It is cruel to leave a dog alone all day. | The king was famous for his cruel punishments.

Definition: thuộc về văn hóa
Pattern: tính từ; cultural differences = khác biệt văn hóa
Examples: The festival celebrates the city's cultural heritage. | Travelling helps you understand cultural differences.

Definition: tiền tệ, đơn vị tiền
Pattern: danh từ; foreign currency = ngoại tệ
Examples: The euro is the currency of many European countries. | You can change your currency at the airport.

Definition: hiện tại, hiện thời
Pattern: tính từ (chính); cũng là danh từ (dòng chảy, dòng điện); đồng nghĩa present
Examples: What is your current address? | The current situation is better than last year.

Definition: hiện nay, hiện thời
Pattern: trạng từ; đồng nghĩa at the moment/now
Examples: She is currently working on a new novel. | The museum is currently closed for repairs.

Definition: rèm cửa, màn
Pattern: danh từ; draw/close the curtains = kéo rèm
Examples: Please close the curtains, it's getting dark. | She pulled back the curtain to look outside.

Definition: phong tục, tập quán; thói quen
Pattern: danh từ; it is the custom to do something; so với customs (hải quan)
Examples: Shaking hands is a common custom when you meet someone. | It is a local custom to give flowers at weddings.

Definition: thiệt hại, hư hại
Pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ; không đếm được; do/cause damage to
Examples: The storm caused serious damage to the roof. | Smoking can damage your lungs.

Definition: thập kỷ, mười năm
Pattern: danh từ; over the past decade = trong thập kỷ qua
Examples: The town has changed a lot in the last decade. | She spent nearly a decade living abroad.

Definition: trang trí, trang hoàng; sơn sửa (nhà)
Pattern: động từ; decorate something with something
Examples: They decorated the hall with balloons and lights. | We are going to decorate the living room this weekend.

Definition: định nghĩa, xác định rõ
Pattern: động từ; define something as; định nghĩa một từ
Examples: It's hard to define exactly what happiness is. | The dictionary defines the word very clearly.

Definition: rõ ràng, chắc chắn, dứt khoát
Pattern: tính từ; trái nghĩa với vague; a definite answer = câu trả lời dứt khoát
Examples: We need a definite answer by Friday. | There has been a definite improvement in her health.

Definition: định nghĩa, lời giải nghĩa
Pattern: danh từ; a definition of something; by definition = theo định nghĩa
Examples: Look up the definition of this word in the dictionary. | Everyone has a different definition of success.

Definition: giao hàng, phân phát; phát biểu; đỡ đẻ
Pattern: động từ; deliver something to somebody; deliver a speech
Examples: The shop can deliver the sofa tomorrow. | She delivered a short speech at the ceremony.

Definition: sự khởi hành, sự ra đi
Pattern: danh từ; trái nghĩa với arrival; the departure time = giờ khởi hành
Examples: The departure of the flight was delayed by two hours. | Check the board for the departure time of your train.

Definition: mặc dù, bất chấp
Pattern: giới từ; theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing; đồng nghĩa in spite of
Examples: Despite the rain, they finished the match. | She passed the exam despite being ill.

Definition: điểm đến, nơi đến
Pattern: danh từ; a holiday destination = điểm du lịch; final destination = điểm đến cuối
Examples: Paris is a popular holiday destination. | We finally reached our destination after a long drive.

Definition: xác định, quyết định; định đoạt
Pattern: động từ; determine the cause; determine whether/how
Examples: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the illness. | Your attitude can determine your success.

Definition: quyết tâm, cương quyết
Pattern: tính từ; determined to do something
Examples: She was determined to finish the race. | He is a determined young man who never gives up.

Definition: sự phát triển; sự kiện mới
Pattern: danh từ; the development of something; recent developments = diễn biến mới
Examples: The development of the internet changed the world. | There have been exciting developments in the case.

Definition: sơ đồ, biểu đồ, hình minh họa
Pattern: danh từ; a diagram of/showing something
Examples: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the process. | The manual includes a diagram of all the parts.

Definition: kim cương; hình thoi
Pattern: danh từ; a diamond ring = nhẫn kim cương
Examples: He gave her a beautiful diamond ring. | The window had small panes in a diamond shape.

Definition: sự khó khăn, trở ngại
Pattern: danh từ; have difficulty (in) doing something; with difficulty = một cách khó khăn
Examples: She had difficulty finding a parking space. | He walked up the stairs with great difficulty.

Definition: trực tiếp; ngay lập tức; thẳng
Pattern: trạng từ; trái nghĩa với indirectly
Examples: You can contact the manager directly by phone. | The road leads directly to the beach.

Definition: đất bẩn, bụi bẩn; đất, bùn
Pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; covered in dirt = lấm bẩn
Examples: His shoes were covered in dirt after the walk. | Wipe the dirt off the window before you paint it.

Definition: điều bất lợi, mặt hạn chế
Pattern: danh từ; trái nghĩa với advantage; at a disadvantage = ở thế bất lợi
Examples: One disadvantage of the job is the long hours. | Not speaking the language put her at a disadvantage.

Definition: thất vọng, buồn vì không được như mong đợi
Pattern: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; be disappointed with/in/about something
Examples: I was disappointed with my exam results. | She looked disappointed when we cancelled the trip.

Definition: đáng thất vọng, gây hụt hẫng
Pattern: tính từ mô tả sự vật/sự việc; phân biệt với disappointed (cảm xúc người)
Examples: The film was really disappointing after all the good reviews. | We had a disappointing start to the season.

Definition: sự giảm giá, chiết khấu
Pattern: danh từ; give/get a discount on something, at a discount
Examples: Students get a 10% discount on train tickets. | I bought these shoes at a big discount.

Definition: không thích, ghét
Pattern: động từ (chính); cũng là danh từ 'sự không thích'; trái nghĩa với like
Examples: I dislike getting up early on cold mornings. | She has a strong dislike of loud music.

Definition: chia, phân chia; chia tách
Pattern: động từ; divide something into/between/among; divide by (toán học)
Examples: Let's divide the cake into eight pieces. | The teacher divided the class into small groups.

Definition: phim tài liệu
Pattern: danh từ; a documentary about/on something
Examples: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa. | He is making a documentary on climate change.

Definition: quyên góp, hiến tặng
Pattern: động từ; donate something to somebody/something
Examples: They donated a lot of money to the hospital. | You can donate blood twice a year.

Definition: sự nghi ngờ, mối hoài nghi
Pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ 'nghi ngờ'; have doubts about, no doubt
Examples: I have no doubt that she will succeed. | There is some doubt about whether the plan will work.

Definition: đã mặc quần áo, ăn mặc (theo kiểu nào đó)
Pattern: tính từ; get dressed (mặc đồ), be dressed in something
Examples: Give me five minutes to get dressed. | She was dressed in a beautiful red dress.

Definition: cái trống
Pattern: danh từ; play the drums (chơi bộ trống)
Examples: He plays the drums in a local band. | The children banged on the drum all afternoon.

Definition: say rượu, say xỉn
Pattern: tính từ; get drunk; trái nghĩa với sober
Examples: He got drunk at the party and sang loudly. | You should never drive when you are drunk.

Definition: đến hạn, dự kiến sẽ; do bởi vì
Pattern: tính từ; be due to do something, due to (vì), due in/on
Examples: The train is due to arrive at six o'clock. | Her essay is due next Monday.

Definition: bụi, bụi bặm
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; a layer of dust, gather/collect dust
Examples: There was a thick layer of dust on the old books. | Please wipe the dust off the shelves.

Definition: nhiệm vụ, bổn phận; thuế (hàng hoá)
Pattern: danh từ; on/off duty (đang/hết ca trực), it is your duty to
Examples: It is the duty of every citizen to vote. | The nurse is on duty until midnight.

Definition: trận động đất
Pattern: danh từ; a strong/powerful earthquake hits/strikes a place
Examples: A powerful earthquake destroyed many homes in the city. | Thousands of people were left homeless by the earthquake.

Definition: thuộc phía đông, miền đông
Pattern: tính từ chỉ phương hướng; đi trước danh từ; so với western
Examples: Heavy rain is expected in the eastern part of the country. | She grew up in a small town in eastern Europe.

Definition: thuộc về kinh tế
Pattern: tính từ; chỉ các vấn đề kinh tế (phân biệt với economical: tiết kiệm)
Examples: The country is facing serious economic problems. | The government promised strong economic growth.

Definition: nền kinh tế; sự tiết kiệm
Pattern: danh từ; a strong/weak economy; economy class (hạng phổ thông)
Examples: The economy is growing faster than last year. | We flew economy class to save money.

Definition: cạnh, rìa, mép; lưỡi (dao)
Pattern: danh từ; on the edge of something, at the edge
Examples: Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff. | She sat on the edge of the bed and cried.

Definition: biên tập viên, người biên tập
Pattern: danh từ; the editor of a newspaper/magazine/book
Examples: She is the editor of a popular fashion magazine. | The editor cut two pages from my article.

Definition: giáo dục, dạy dỗ
Pattern: động từ; educate somebody about something, be educated at
Examples: Schools should educate children about healthy eating. | He was educated at a famous university in London.

Definition: có học thức, được đào tạo
Pattern: tính từ; well educated, highly educated
Examples: She is a well educated and thoughtful woman. | Highly educated people still make mistakes.

Definition: mang tính giáo dục, có tính học tập
Pattern: tính từ; educational games/programmes/toys
Examples: The museum offers many educational activities for kids. | This app is both fun and educational.

Definition: hiệu quả, có tác dụng
Pattern: tính từ; an effective way/method of doing something; trái nghĩa ineffective
Examples: Exercise is an effective way to reduce stress. | We need a more effective method to solve this.

Definition: một cách hiệu quả; trên thực tế
Pattern: trạng từ; bổ nghĩa cho động từ; cũng nghĩa 'thực chất là'
Examples: The new system works very effectively. | The two sides effectively agreed on everything.

Definition: sự nỗ lực, cố gắng
Pattern: danh từ; make an effort to do something, put effort into
Examples: She made a big effort to finish on time. | It took a lot of effort to climb the mountain.

Definition: cuộc bầu cử
Pattern: danh từ; hold/win/lose an election, a general election
Examples: The country will hold an election next spring. | Their party won the last election.

Definition: yếu tố, thành phần; nguyên tố (hoá học)
Pattern: danh từ; a key/important element of something
Examples: Trust is a key element of any friendship. | Water is made of two chemical elements.

Definition: ngượng ngùng, xấu hổ
Pattern: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; feel/be embarrassed about something
Examples: I felt really embarrassed when I forgot his name. | She was too embarrassed to ask for help.

Definition: gây ngượng, khó xử
Pattern: tính từ mô tả tình huống; phân biệt với embarrassed (cảm xúc người)
Examples: Falling over in front of everyone was so embarrassing. | He told an embarrassing story about his childhood.

Definition: tình huống khẩn cấp
Pattern: danh từ; in an emergency, an emergency exit/number
Examples: Call this number in an emergency. | The plane had to make an emergency landing.

Definition: cảm xúc, tình cảm
Pattern: danh từ; show/hide/control your emotions
Examples: He spoke about the war with great emotion. | It is healthy to express your emotions.

Definition: việc làm, sự thuê mướn lao động
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; find employment, full-time employment; trái nghĩa unemployment
Examples: She found employment at a local hospital. | The new factory will create employment for the area.

Definition: khuyến khích, động viên
Pattern: động từ; encourage somebody to do something; trái nghĩa discourage
Examples: My parents encouraged me to study abroad. | Good teachers encourage students to ask questions.

Definition: kẻ thù, kẻ địch
Pattern: danh từ; make enemies, a bitter enemy; trái nghĩa friend
Examples: The two countries were enemies for many years. | He made a few enemies during his career.

Definition: đã đính hôn; đang bận
Pattern: tính từ; be/get engaged to somebody; cũng nghĩa máy bận (điện thoại)
Examples: They got engaged last summer and will marry soon. | I tried to call her, but the line was engaged.

Definition: ngành kỹ thuật, công trình kỹ thuật
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; civil/mechanical/software engineering
Examples: He is studying engineering at university. | The bridge is a great piece of engineering.

Definition: giải trí, mua vui; tiếp đãi
Pattern: động từ; entertain somebody with something; entertain guests
Examples: The clown entertained the children for an hour. | They love to entertain friends at home.

Definition: sự giải trí, trò tiêu khiển
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; live entertainment, for entertainment
Examples: The hotel offers live entertainment every night. | People use their phones mostly for entertainment.

Definition: lối vào, cổng vào; sự đi vào

Definition: thất nghiệp, không có việc làm
Pattern: tính từ; the unemployed (những người thất nghiệp); trái với employed
Examples: He has been unemployed since the factory closed. | The number of unemployed workers is rising.

Definition: tình trạng thất nghiệp; nạn thất nghiệp
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; unemployment rate (tỷ lệ thất nghiệp)
Examples: Unemployment is a serious problem in the region. | The government wants to reduce unemployment.

Definition: không công bằng, bất công
Pattern: tính từ; unfair to somebody; it's unfair that...; trái với fair
Examples: It's unfair that she has to do all the work. | The referee made an unfair decision.

Definition: công đoàn; liên minh, sự hợp nhất
Pattern: danh từ; trade/labour union (công đoàn); the European Union
Examples: The workers joined a union to protect their rights. | The two states formed a union many years ago.

Definition: trừ khi, nếu không
Pattern: liên từ; mệnh đề unless + hiện tại, mang nghĩa phủ định của if
Examples: We will go for a walk unless it rains. | You won't pass the exam unless you study harder.

Definition: không giống, khác với
Pattern: giới từ; unlike somebody/something; trái với like
Examples: Unlike her sister, she hates sport. | This phone is quite unlike the one I had before.

Definition: khó xảy ra, khó có khả năng
Pattern: tính từ; it is unlikely that...; be unlikely to do something; trái với likely
Examples: It's unlikely that he will arrive on time. | She is unlikely to change her mind now.

Definition: không cần thiết, thừa
Pattern: tính từ; trái với necessary; it is unnecessary to do something
Examples: He made a lot of unnecessary mistakes. | It's unnecessary to book a ticket in advance.

Definition: khó chịu, không dễ chịu
Pattern: tính từ; trái với pleasant; dùng cho mùi, trải nghiệm, con người
Examples: There was an unpleasant smell in the kitchen. | She had an unpleasant experience at the hotel.

Definition: cập nhật (động từ); bản cập nhật (danh từ)
Pattern: động từ và danh từ; update somebody on something; an update on/about something
Examples: Please update your password every few months. | I'll give you an update on the project tomorrow.

Definition: buồn bực, khó chịu (tính từ); làm buồn, làm đảo lộn (động từ)
Pattern: be upset about/by something; động từ bất quy tắc upset-upset-upset
Examples: She was really upset about losing her job. | I didn't mean to upset you with my words.

Definition: đã qua sử dụng, cũ; quen (be used to)
Pattern: tính từ; used cars (xe cũ); be/get used to doing something (quen với)
Examples: They bought a used car to save money. | I'm not used to getting up so early.

Definition: có giá trị, quý giá; đáng quý
Pattern: tính từ; valuable advice/experience; cũng chỉ giá trị vật chất
Examples: Her advice was very valuable to me. | Keep your valuable items in the hotel safe.

Definition: giá trị
Pattern: danh từ; good value (for money); the value of something
Examples: The painting has great artistic value. | This phone is good value for money.

Definition: đa dạng, nhiều loại khác nhau
Pattern: tính từ đứng trước danh từ số nhiều; đồng nghĩa several, different
Examples: The museum has objects from various countries. | We discussed the problem for various reasons.

Definition: phiên bản; bản (khác nhau)
Pattern: danh từ; a new/old version of something; a version of a story
Examples: This is the latest version of the software. | He told a different version of the story.

Definition: nạn nhân
Pattern: danh từ; a victim of something; fall victim to (trở thành nạn nhân)
Examples: The flood left many victims without a home. | She was a victim of an online scam.

Definition: người xem (truyền hình, video)
Pattern: danh từ; chỉ khán giả xem TV/video; khác reader (người đọc)
Examples: Millions of viewers watched the final match. | The show is popular with young viewers.

Definition: bạo lực, hung bạo; dữ dội
Pattern: tính từ; a violent crime/storm; trạng từ violently
Examples: The film contains some violent scenes. | A violent storm hit the coast last night.

Definition: tình nguyện viên (danh từ); tình nguyện, xung phong (động từ)
Pattern: động từ: volunteer to do something; volunteer for something
Examples: She works as a volunteer at the local hospital. | He volunteered to help clean up the beach.

Definition: phiếu bầu, cuộc bỏ phiếu (danh từ); bỏ phiếu (động từ)
Pattern: vote for/against somebody/something; have the right to vote
Examples: Each member has one vote at the meeting. | Most people voted for the new plan.

Definition: cảnh báo, báo trước
Pattern: động từ; warn somebody about/of something; warn somebody (not) to do something
Examples: The teacher warned us about the difficult test. | She warned him not to drive too fast.

Definition: lời cảnh báo, sự cảnh báo
Pattern: danh từ; a warning about/of something; without warning (không báo trước)
Examples: The sign is a warning about the deep water. | The storm arrived without any warning.

Definition: sự lãng phí; rác thải (danh từ); lãng phí (động từ)
Pattern: waste time/money on something; a waste of time; danh từ không đếm được (rác)
Examples: Don't waste your money on things you don't need. | The factory produces a lot of waste.

Definition: vũ khí
Pattern: danh từ; nghĩa bóng: a powerful weapon against something
Examples: The police found a weapon at the scene. | Knowledge is a powerful weapon against fear.

Definition: cân; nặng (bao nhiêu)
Pattern: động từ; weigh something (cân vật gì); it weighs + trọng lượng
Examples: Can you weigh these apples for me, please? | The baby weighs about four kilograms.

Definition: phương Tây; miền tây
Pattern: tính từ; western culture/countries; viết hoa Western khi chỉ văn hóa phương Tây
Examples: Western countries often celebrate Christmas in December. | They travelled to the western part of the island.

Definition: bất cứ cái gì, dù gì đi nữa
Pattern: vừa là từ hạn định vừa là đại từ; whatever you want; whatever happens
Examples: You can order whatever you like from the menu. | Whatever happens, I will always support you.

Definition: bất cứ khi nào, mỗi khi
Pattern: liên từ; whenever + mệnh đề; nhấn mạnh mọi lần hoặc thời điểm bất kỳ
Examples: Call me whenever you need help. | Whenever it rains, the roads get very busy.

Definition: liệu... hay không; dù
Pattern: liên từ; whether or not; dùng sau động từ như ask, know, decide
Examples: I'm not sure whether he will come or not. | She asked me whether I liked the film.

Definition: mạng không dây Wi-Fi
Pattern: danh từ; connect to the Wi-Fi; Wi-Fi password/connection
Examples: Is there free Wi-Fi in this café? | The Wi-Fi is too slow to watch videos.

Definition: cánh (chim, máy bay); cánh (tòa nhà)
Pattern: danh từ; the wing of a bird/plane; the east wing of a building
Examples: The bird spread its wings and flew away. | We sat near the wing of the plane.

Definition: trong vòng, bên trong; trong phạm vi
Pattern: giới từ chỉ thời gian hoặc không gian; within a week; within the building
Examples: The doctor will see you within ten minutes. | Everything you need is within walking distance.

Definition: tự hỏi, thắc mắc (động từ); điều kỳ diệu (danh từ)
Pattern: động từ: wonder if/whether/what...; danh từ: a wonder of the world
Examples: I wonder why she left so early. | The pyramids are one of the wonders of the world.

Definition: len, lông cừu
Pattern: danh từ không đếm được; made of wool; a wool/woollen sweater
Examples: This jumper is made of pure wool. | Wool keeps you warm in cold weather.

Definition: toàn thế giới, khắp thế giới (tính từ và trạng từ)
Pattern: vừa tính từ vừa trạng từ; a worldwide problem; sell something worldwide
Examples: The company has a worldwide reputation. | The book has sold millions of copies worldwide.

Definition: đáng giá, trị giá; đáng (làm gì)
Pattern: tính từ; be worth + số tiền; be worth doing something
Examples: The house is worth a lot of money now. | This museum is really worth visiting.

Definition: bằng văn bản, viết ra
Pattern: tính từ; a written test/agreement; trái với spoken/oral
Examples: You will need written permission from your parents. | There is a written exam and a speaking exam.

Definition: sân (sau nhà); thước Anh (đơn vị yard)
Pattern: danh từ; a yard (đơn vị độ dài ≈ 0,91 m); back yard (sân sau)
Examples: The children were playing in the back yard. | The shop is just a few yards down the street.

Definition: tuổi trẻ, thời thanh niên; thanh niên
Pattern: danh từ; in his/her youth; the youth of today (giới trẻ ngày nay)
Examples: He travelled a lot in his youth. | The club offers many activities for local youth.
